doc.title: Bobby Hutcherson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Birth in Los Angeles, raised in Pasadena
summary: Born Robert Howard Hutcherson in Los Angeles in 1941 though the family lived in Pasadena; relatives helped at the birth.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Robert Howard Hutcherson. I was born January 27, 1941, in Los Angeles, but I grew up in Pasadena, California.
But you say you were born in Los Angeles.

No. It was – they were living in Pasadena, but a lot of my relatives were living in Los Angeles, Watts and stuff like that. So it worked out, because they could be there. My mom had me very late in her life, in those days, and so it was better for my father to take my mother to the Los Angeles hospital, because he was – his work, he was a bricklayer. So he – my aunt – two of my aunts would be there to help. One lived in Watts and one lived in what they call now south central L.A. I didn’t know about south central L.A. until I grew up. That was – I didn’t realize that that’s where I was. I thought that was the hip part of town.
